summary: Arqit Quantum Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 1, 2026, announcing the appointment of Cristina Levis as a Class I independent director and Audit Committee member. The filing details her extensive finance and executive background. This is a routine board appointment, not a sudden or forced departure, but it is categorized as a management change since it involves a director addition. No terms, deal structure, or strategic implications are discussed. The event is a standard governance update with no special-situation impact.
